battle.name: 唐滅東突厥之戰
battle.brief: 貞觀三年（629）十一月，唐太宗分六道兵馬北伐，李靖以三千精騎自馬邑疾馳，夜襲惡陽嶺，焚頡利可汗於定襄鐵山的牙帳，李勣自朔方截其歸路，頡利走保磧口被擒。卡面埃及長矛早此役數千年，但唐軍的長槊陣與障車拒馬，正是同一套以長矛守陣、以弓弩開路的步兵邏輯。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 交戰的兩方是唐朝與東突厥汗庭。唐太宗在貞觀三年九月下詔分六道出師，兵部尚書李靖為定襄道行軍總管，柴紹、李勣、張公謹、丘行恭、李道宗各領一軍，指揮靠行軍總管府與兵部、度支的轉輸系統。府兵是骨幹，蕃兵與內附的突厥部眾編為騎隊，糧秣自靈州、朔州、馬邑、定襄四處屯倉供應。東突厥以牙帳為中樞，左右賢王、俟斤、達干各領一部，控弦之眾號稱百萬，牙帳能直接調度的不過數萬；部眾披皮袍與小片革甲，用角弓、骨鏃與短槊，帳幕以氈，駱駝馱載帳篷與乳酪，馬匹與人眾分屬各部，號令出於牙帳而各部自有其屬。兩家表面稱臣納貢，實則連年南下，貞觀初年頡利曾率眾逼近關中，長安戒嚴。故唐廷先分化其外圍：拉攏鐵勒、靺鞨，令突利可汗一部與牙帳內應，最後以李靖所部作斬首之舉。
countriesEn: The two parties were the Tang court and the court of the Eastern Turks. In the ninth month of Zhenguan 3 (629) Emperor Taizong issued an edict sending the army out in six columns: Li Jing, Minister of War, as military governor of the Dingxiang circuit, with Chai Shao, Li Ji, Zhang Gongjin, Qiu Xenggong and Li Daozong each leading a force of his own. Command ran through the offices of the military governors together with the Ministry of War and the Ministry of Revenue, which handled transport. The fubing formed the backbone, tribal auxiliaries and Turkic divisions already come over to the Tang were formed into the cavalry, and the grain was drawn from the storehouses at Lingzhou, Shuofang, Mayi and Dingxiang. On the Turkic side the yurt was the hub, with the left and right wise-kings, the serks and the darqans each leading a division; the host was said to number a hundred thousand bowmen, yet what the yurt could move directly was some tens of thousands. The people wore sheepskin coats and small pieces of leather armour, used composite bows, bone arrowheads and short spears, lived in tents of felt, and moved their tents and dairy on camels; the horses and the people belonged to each division, and while orders came from the yurt each division had its own. The two sides kept up a court that paid tribute while raiding year after year; in the early Zhenguan years Jieli brought his host close to the Guanzhong plain and Chang'an was put on the alert. The Tang therefore began by dividing the enemy's periphery: drawing the Tiele and the Mohe to their side, using the division of Tuli Khan and agents inside the yurt, and keeping Li Jing's force for the stroke at the head.
people: 關鍵人物分四組。其一是太宗李世民：他本欲親征涇陽，長孫無忌、房玄齡、魏徵等力諫乃止；戰前以諸道分兵制衡將門，戰後親至定襄城下迎接歸順諸部，渭水之會盟亦出自他手，頡利入朝後又命其觀洛陽府庫之積。其二是主帥李靖：用兵喜出其不意，選驍騎三千自馬邑疾馳，十餘日抵惡陽嶺，雨不停也不肯退，諸將請止而不許，一戰破頡利牙帳，東方諸部望風披靡。其三是諸道將領：李勣以朔方道行軍總管截斷頡利北走的退路，是最能與李靖配合的老將；柴紹、張公謹、丘行恭、李道宗各道一軍，李道宗部將張寶相追至磧口，生擒頡利可汗；蘇定方為李靖前鋒，鐵山夜襲時率騎直薄牙帳。其四是突厥一方：頡利年輕時曾以騎兵助隋征高句麗，統一漠北後卻在分化與奇襲之下失去全部主動；突利可汗一部先已內附唐朝，乞力可汗、達干各懷異志，汗庭的號令出了牙帳便難以落實。
peopleEn: The key figures fall into four groups. The first is Emperor Taizong, Li Shimin: he had wanted to ride to Jingyang himself and was argued out of it by Zhangsun Wuji, Fang Xuanling, Wei Zheng and the rest. Before the campaign he divided the forces among the circuits so that no single general should dominate; after it he went himself to the foot of Dingxiang to receive the divisions that came in; the covenant at the Wei was his own doing; and when Jieli was brought to court he had him shown the stores of Luoyang. The second is the commander, Li Jing: a man who liked to appear where he was not expected, who took three thousand picked riders out of Mayi, reached Ayang Ridge in something over ten days, would not stop in the rain though his officers asked him to, and who broke Jieli's yurt in a single stroke, after which the eastern divisions came apart at the news. The third are the commanders of the other circuits: Li Ji, as military governor of Shuofang, barred the road by which Jieli might flee north, and was the old general best able to work with Li Jing; Chai Shao, Zhang Gongjin, Qiu Xenggong and Li Daozong each led a column, and among Li Daozong's men Zhang Baoxiang pursued to Qikou and took Jieli alive; Su Dingfang was Li Jing's vanguard and led the horse straight against the yurt in the night attack at Tieshan. The fourth is the Turkic side: Jieli, who as a young man had ridden with Turkic horse to help the Sui against Goguryeo and who, after uniting the northern desert, lost every initiative under division and surprise; the division of Tuli Khan had come over to the Tang long before, Qili Khan and the darqans each had their own interest, and an order from the yurt was hard to carry out once it left the tent.
kits: 卡面那件埃及長矛是早王朝時期的產物：銅或青銅矛頭以繩索綁在木杆上，形制簡陋卻足以在城牆缺口排成拒馬，埃及人靠它守城垣，後來也用同一種武器收復失地。近四千年之後，唐軍腳下沒有青銅，只有精鐵：長槊通長約二丈，槊刃不過尺餘，握處纏麻，步卒以兩手持握，列陣時槊鋒如林，專用於正面拒馬與壓制騎兵；馬上則用單手可揮的短馬槊。同一套分工在細節上相通：埃及人把長矛架在城垣缺口，唐軍把長槊插在障車之前拒斥騎兵，都用一根長杆加一枚金屬頭去代替盾牌的正面遮蔽。除長槊外，唐軍有陌刀與橫刀、漆布或木胎蒙革的方盾、角弓與步弩、排弩，攻堅則用雲梯、搭敵樓車與燃燒箭；火攻在雪夜尤其關鍵，李靖焚牙帳即用火。突厥側以角弓配骨鏃、石鏃，短槊、佩刀、套索，披皮袍小甲而不披重甲，帳幕、鼓角與乳酪靠駱駝馱載，馬是他們唯一的機動與載具。
kitsEn: The kit on this card, the Egyptian spear, is a product of the early dynastic period: a copper or bronze head bound with cord onto a wooden shaft, a plain enough form that could be ranked into a fence of points at a breach in a city wall, and the Egyptians used it to hold ramparts and later to recover lost ground with the same weapon. Nearly four thousand years separate it from this campaign, and the Tang had no bronze but good iron: the long spear ran about two zhang in all, its blade a little over a chi, the grip wrapped in hemp, and the foot soldiers held it in both hands, so that the ranks of points stood out like a forest and were used to hold the line and turn horse; on horseback a shorter spear was used, one that could be swung single-handed. The division of labour is the same in its details: the Egyptians set long spears along a breach in the wall, the Tang fixed long spears in front of the barricade carts to turn horse, and in both cases a single shaft with a metal head took the place of the shield's frontal cover. Besides the long spear the Tang had the modao and the cross-bladed sabre, square shields of wood covered with lacquered cloth or hide, composite bows, single and splayed crossbows, and for the attack on works, scaling ladders, siege towers and fire arrows; fire mattered most on a snowy night, for the burning of the yurt by Li Jing was done with fire. The Turks on their side had composite bows with bone and stone arrowheads, short spears, sabres, lassos, sheepskin coats and small pieces of leather rather than heavy armour, and their tents, drums and dairy were carried on camels; the horse was their only means of movement and of carrying.
tactics: 唐軍的戰術分三段。第一段是奇襲斬首：貞觀三年十一月，李靖率驍騎三千自馬邑出其不意，晝伏夜行，十餘日抵惡陽嶺，遇雨不止，直趨鐵山；距頡利牙帳七百里時諸將請止，靖以為機不可失，及至頡利尚寢，靖令蘇定方掩擊，焚其牙帳，頡利驚走。第二段是諸道合擊與追擊：柴紹自靈州、李勣自朔方、丘行恭等各道同時壓上，李勣在烏道夜行破突厥游騎千餘，截斷北走之路；李道宗率騎追至磧口，張寶相擒頡利。第三段是政治攻心：牙帳既失，諸部尚屯於定襄一線，太宗率諸軍至渭水南，與諸帥隔水而語，設酒相會，以渭水為界，諸部乃引眾北歸。兵種配合上，步弩與排弩在前排覆蓋射界，角弓射手在兩翼策應，長槊手在缺口頂住衝鋒，騎兵靠馬力追擊與繞擊，正是埃及長矛守城時先以矢石壓城垣、再以長矛逐出缺口的同一節奏。
tacticsEn: The Tang method ran in three movements. The first was the surprise stroke at the head: in the eleventh month of Zhenguan 3, Li Jing took three thousand picked riders out of Mayi unexpectedly, lay up by day and marched by night, reached Ayang Ridge in something over ten days, pushed on through the rain, and when his officers asked him to stop at seven hundred li from Jieli's yurt he judged the chance too good to lose. By the time he arrived Jieli was still asleep, so Li Jing sent Su Dingfang to fall upon the camp and burn the yurt, and Jieli fled. The second was the convergence of the columns and the pursuit: Chai Shao came from Lingzhou, Li Ji from Shuofang, Qiu Xenggong and the rest pressed in at the same time, Li Ji marching by night through Wudao broke a thousand Turkic riders and cut the road of escape, Li Daozong rode in pursuit to Qikou, and Zhang Baoxiang took Jieli. The third was the political offensive: with the head of the khanate gone, the divisions were still posted on the Dingxiang line, and Taizong came down to the south bank of the Wei with his armies, spoke with the Turkic commanders across the water, a feast was set, the Wei was taken as the line, and the divisions led their people north. In the order of the arms, single and splayed crossbows gave the long-range fire from the front ranks, bow archers supported from the flanks, the long spears stood at the gaps to hold the charge, and the horse did the pursuit and the turning stroke. It is the same rhythm with which the Egyptian spear held a wall, first the arrows and stones weighing down the rampart, then the spears driving out of the breach.
data: 數字要打折看。《資治通鑑》記李靖所部驍騎三千，李勣一路步騎十萬，諸道合兵則有「三十餘萬」一類概數，其中顯然包含大量蕃兵與運糧丁夫。鐵山一戰，史料記斬首萬餘級、俘虜男女十餘萬、雜畜數十萬頭，這類數字把被擄走的部眾與牲畜一併算入，無法核對。行程方面，馬邑至惡陽嶺數百里，全軍行十餘日至鐵山，自鐵山至頡利牙帳尚有七百里，突擊階段日行二百餘里，銜枚疾進不設營，與通鑑「進擊定襄，破之」的記載相合；追奔至磧口又是數百里。糧秣是硬限制：唐軍以靈州、朔州、馬邑、定襄為屯糧之所，騎兵作戰一日耗馬料數倍，離開這四處據點便難以維持，故追擊雖銳而不能深入漠北。會盟時，突厥諸部尚屯兵於定襄一線，騎兵數以萬計，太宗親至渭水時隨行甲士數千，營壘沿渭水一線列開，以此壓住會盟的場合。
dataEn: Figures of troops have to be taken with a discount. The Comprehensive Mirror records three thousand picked riders under Li Jing, a hundred thousand foot and horse in Li Ji's column, and for the columns together a round figure of some three hundred thousand, which plainly includes a great many auxiliaries and the men transporting grain. For the battle at Tieshan the sources give more than ten thousand heads cut off, more than a hundred thousand men and women taken, and some hundreds of thousands of head of mixed livestock; such figures fold in the people carried off and the animals and cannot be checked. On distance: from Mayi to Ayang Ridge is some hundreds of li, the column took something over ten days to reach Tieshan, another seven hundred li lay between Tieshan and Jieli's yurt, during the stroke it covered more than two hundred li a day and marched at night with the horses tied and the men silent, without pitching camp, which agrees with the record of taking Dingxiang and breaking it; the pursuit on to Qikou was several hundred li more. Supply was the hard limit: the Tang drew its grain from Lingzhou, Shuofang, Mayi and Dingxiang, and a horse at work consumed several times its keep in a day, so once the army left those four points it could no longer be fed, and that is why the pursuit was sharp but did not go deep into the northern desert. At the time of the covenant the Turkic divisions were still posted on the Dingxiang line with some tens of thousands of horse, and when Taizong came to the Wei he had a few thousand armoured men with him, the camp drawn up along the river to give weight to the occasion.
cause: 打起來有遠因也有近因。近因是頡利可汗在貞觀初年統一漠北之後連年南下：部眾號稱百萬，馬匹充足，弓箭精準，唐廷深以為患，關中多次戒嚴，太宗曾有親征涇陽之議，長安上下以為非增兵不足以抵禦。遠因是唐朝自身的邊防取向：隋末以來北邊諸部多附於突厥，唐若要讓漠北恢復漢家的羈縻格局，就必須先打掉這個核心。促成開戰的還有雙方的時間表：突厥連年用兵，部眾疲於奔命，馬力下降；唐軍經兩三年整備已練出精騎，一旦探知牙帳位置與路徑，就決定以一次奇襲取代正面會戰。汗庭內部並不齊整亦是一個條件：突利可汗一部早已內附唐朝，唐在牙帳內有嚮導、有情報，也有鐵勒、靺鞨願意倒戈的渠道；唐廷也清楚，一旦開打，必須在頡利重整之前打散其諸部，否則汗國只是受創而不會崩潰。
causeEn: There was a distant cause and an immediate one. The immediate cause was that Jieli Khan came south year after year after uniting the northern desert in the early Zhenguan years: his host was said to number a hundred thousand, his horses were plentiful and his archers accurate, the court at Chang'an took the danger seriously, the capital was placed on the alert more than once, and Taizong at one point spoke of riding to Jingyang himself, his ministers judging that without more troops the frontier could not be held. The distant cause was the orientation of Tang frontier policy itself: since the end of the Sui the northern peoples had mostly attached themselves to the Turks, and if the Tang were to restore the old Han pattern of command over the northern desert, it had to break that core first. There was also a timetable on both sides. The Turks had campaigned continuously, the divisions were worn out by constant movement and the horses were failing; the Tang had spent two or three years preparing and could now field picked horse, and once the position of the yurt and the road to it were known, it was decided to replace a set-piece battle with one surprise stroke. The court of the khanate was not whole, which was a condition in itself: the division of Tuli Khan had come over to the Tang long before, so the Tang had guides and intelligence inside the yurt and channels through which the Tiele and the Mohe would turn. The court at Chang'an also understood that once the fighting began it had to break the divisions apart before Jieli could put them in order again; otherwise the khanate would only be wounded and would not fall.
impact: 這一戰改變了北亞的權力格局。頡利可汗被擒、牙帳覆沒之後，東突厥的汗庭權威就此崩解，數十萬部眾北走或散歸各部，唐朝在漠南以定襄、雲中等都督府和羈縻州縣收編內附諸部，並在極北以「以夷制夷」的方式冊立鐵勒、迴紇等部的首領、開放邊市，讓漠北各部互相牽制，而不必年年出塞。制度上的好處是唐朝從此不再倚賴長城，邊防支點由牆垣轉為都督府與羈縻群；壞處是留給後世的是一份更長的帳單：漠北秩序並未一勞永逸，鐵勒、迴紇先後強大，車師、薛延陀反覆，直到貞觀二十年（646）滅薛延陀、勒石燕然，漠北才真正安定。對唐廷本身，這是貞觀年間最見效的一次邊功，太宗由此確立了對北方「冊封羈縻、邊市換馬」的思路，後來平高昌、滅高句麗、征薛延陀都沿用同一套節奏；而被拆散的突厥部眾各自尋找出路，日後以車師、薛延陀、迴紇的名義再度北上。
impactEn: This campaign changed the balance of power in northern Asia. With Jieli taken and the yurt destroyed, the authority of the Eastern Turkic court collapsed at once, several hundred thousand people moved north or scattered back to their divisions, and in the south of the desert the Tang gathered the surrendered peoples into commanderies and dependent prefectures and counties at Dingxiang, Yunzhong and elsewhere, while in the far north they ruled the Tiele, the Huihe and other chiefs by grant and recognition and opened the border markets, so that the tribes of the northern desert held one another in check and the court no longer had to ride out every year. The institutional gain was that the Tang no longer leaned on a wall: the pivot of the frontier shifted from ramparts to commanderies and dependent peoples. The cost was a longer bill handed down to later ages. The order of the northern desert did not settle for good; the Tiele and the Huihe grew strong in turn, Chushi and Xueyantuo kept coming back, until the defeat of Xueyantuo in Zhenguan 20 (646) and the stone carved at Yanran left the northern desert genuinely quiet. For the court at Chang'an this was the most effective piece of frontier work of the Zhenguan years, and it fixed the Tang pattern for the north, granting titles and holding dependent peoples and trading horses at the border market; the reduction of Gaochang, the war against Goguryeo and the campaign against Xueyantuo were all run to the same rhythm. The Turkic peoples scattered by the campaign each looked for their own road, and some of them came north again in later years under the names of Chushi, Xueyantuo and Huihe.
result: 結果是唐軍完勝。鐵山一戰破頡利牙帳之後，頡利北走保磧口，為其部將張寶相所擒，貞觀四年（630）正月解送長安；太宗赦其死罪，授郡公爵位，宴之於順天宮，又令其觀洛陽府庫之積，俾知中國之富。諸部則於渭水之會盟，約以渭水為界，引眾北歸，東突厥從此名存實亡。戰術層面，此役確立了唐初對草原的標準打法：精騎奇襲破首、諸道合擊收尾、會盟收編諸部，不以大戰而以瓦解一個汗國。兵制層面則留下兩個問題：一是府兵制的騎兵本錢有限，湊出數千精騎需要長時間整備，一旦錯失奇襲的時機便難再勝；二是被打散的突厥部眾成了新的邊患，貞觀末年仍有侵擾，直到貞觀二十年以後才基本清理完。
resultEn: The result was a complete Tang victory. After the yurt was broken at Tieshan, Jieli fled north and held at Qikou, where he was taken alive by his own officer Zhang Baoxiang, and was sent to Chang'an in the first month of Zhenguan 4 (630). Taizong pardoned him from the death sentence, gave him a command and the title of a commandery prince, feasted him at the Shuntian Palace, and had him shown the stores of Luoyang so that he would know how rich the Middle Kingdom was. The divisions met in the covenant at the Wei, agreed the Wei as the line and led their people north, so that the Eastern Turks survived in name only. At the level of method, the campaign set the standard Tang answer to the steppe: picked horse striking the head by surprise, the columns converging to finish the business, and a covenant to gather in the divisions, an entire khanate undone without a pitched battle. At the level of institutions it left two problems. The fubing system had a limited stock of horse, and to assemble several thousand picked riders took long preparation; once the moment for surprise was missed the victory could not simply be repeated. And the Turkic peoples scattered by the campaign became a new source of trouble on the frontier, still raiding in the late Zhenguan years and only finally cleared up after Zhenguan 20.
